sous_titre: Fonds indiciels et fonds indiciels cotés, en Mds $, de fin 2025 à juillet 2026

series.nom: Encours des fonds indiciels et fonds indiciels cotés

Fin 2025.texte: By year-end 2025, total net assets in these two index fund categories had grown to $19.1 trillion.

Mars 2026.texte: the combined assets of the nation's indexed mutual funds and ETFs decreased by $973.78 billion, or 4.9 percent, to $19.09 trillion in March

Mai 2026.texte: the combined assets of the nation's indexed mutual funds and ETFs increased by $1.00 trillion, or 4.8 percent, to $21.82 trillion in May

Juillet 2026.texte: the combined assets of the nation's indexed mutual funds and ETFs decreased by $119.06 billion, or 0.5%, to $21.76 trillion in July
